The '''CK-H.2 turbofan engine''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Podracer engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Heavy weight, the [[Turbofan/Legends|turbofans]] slowed the [[CR-17 Incendia III]] down significantly.<ref name="EV" />
